question: The OpenTelemetry Collector core has introduced a new top-level scraper package (go.opentelemetry.io/collector/scraper) that defines scraper.Metrics, scraper.Logs, and scraper.Factory interfaces. Which receiver factory files and scraper implementation files across opentelemetry-collector-contrib use these new scraper package interfaces?

answer.summary: The new top-level scraper package (go.opentelemetry.io/collector/scraper) in the OpenTelemetry Collector core defines scraper.Metrics (requiring ScrapeMetrics(context.Context) (pmetric.Metrics, error)), scraper.Logs (requiring ScrapeLogs(context.Context) (plog.Logs, error)), and scraper.Factory (with CreateMetrics/CreateLogs factory methods using scraper.Settings). Across opentelemetry-collector-contrib, the following receiver factory and scraper implementation files use these interfaces for the requested receiver categories:

receiver_factory.usage: Defines a map[component.Type]scraper.Factory via mustMakeFactories() that registers all 11 sub-scraper factories. Uses createAddScraperOptions() to iterate scrapers and call scraperhelper.AddFactoryWithConfig(factory, cfg). Each sub-scraper factory is wrapped via internal.NewEnvVarFactory(factory, envMap) for gopsutil environment variable injection.

internal_scraper_wrapper.usage: Defines NewEnvVarFactory(delegate scraper.Factory, envMap common.EnvMap) scraper.Factory which wraps a delegate factory via scraper.NewFactory() and scraper.WithMetrics(). Returns an envVarScraper struct implementing scraper.Metrics interface (ScrapeMetrics, Start, Shutdown methods).

cpuscraper.pattern: NewFactory() returns scraper.Factory via scraper.NewFactory(metadata.Type, createDefaultConfig, scraper.WithMetrics(createMetricsScraper, metadata.MetricsStability)). createMetricsScraper returns scraper.Metrics via scraper.NewMetrics(s.scrape, scraper.WithStart(s.start)).

diskscraper.pattern: Same pattern as cpuscraper. scraper.NewMetrics(s.scrape, scraper.WithStart(s.start)).

loadscraper.pattern: Same factory pattern. Uses scraper.NewMetrics(s.scrape, scraper.WithStart(s.start), scraper.WithShutdown(s.shutdown)) — the only hostmetrics sub-scraper that also uses scraper.WithShutdown.

processscraper.pattern: Same factory pattern. scraper.NewMetrics(s.scrape, scraper.WithStart(s.start)). Also has OS restriction (linux/windows/darwin/freebsd only).

nfsscraper.pattern: Same factory pattern. scraper.NewMetrics(nfsScraper.scrape, scraper.WithStart(nfsScraper.start)). Linux only.

systemscraper.pattern: Same factory pattern. scraper.NewMetrics(systemScraper.scrape, scraper.WithStart(systemScraper.start)). Linux/Windows/macOS only.

mysqlreceiver.usage: createMetricsReceiver uses scraper.NewMetrics(ns.scrape, scraper.WithStart(ns.start), scraper.WithShutdown(ns.shutdown)). createLogsReceiver creates log scrapers for top queries and query samples using scraper.NewLogs(ns.scrapeTopQueryFunc/ns.scrapeQuerySampleFunc, scraper.WithStart, scraper.WithShutdown), then wraps each in scraper.NewFactory(metadata.Type, nil, scraper.WithLogs(...)) for AddFactoryWithConfig.

postgresqlreceiver.usage: createMetricsReceiver uses scraper.NewMetrics(ns.scrape, scraper.WithShutdown(ns.shutdown)). createLogsReceiver creates log scrapers for query samples and top queries using scraper.NewLogs(), then wraps in scraper.NewFactory(metadata.Type, nil, scraper.WithLogs(..., component.StabilityLevelAlpha)) for AddFactoryWithConfig.

mongodbreceiver.usage: createMetricsReceiver uses scraper.NewMetrics(ms.scrape, scraper.WithStart(ms.start), scraper.WithShutdown(ms.shutdown)), then passes to scraperhelper.NewMetricsController with AddMetricsScraper.

elasticsearchreceiver.usage: createMetricsReceiver uses scraper.NewMetrics(es.scrape, scraper.WithStart(es.start)), then passes to scraperhelper.NewMetricsController with AddMetricsScraper.

redisreceiver.usage: factory.go does NOT directly import scraper, only scraperhelper. The scraper creation is in redis_scraper.go: newRedisScraper returns scraper.Metrics via newRedisScraperWithClient which calls scraper.NewMetrics(rs.Scrape, scraper.WithShutdown(rs.shutdown)). The factory then passes the result to scraperhelper.NewMetricsController with AddMetricsScraper.

kubeletstatsreceiver.usage: factory.go does NOT directly import scraper, only scraperhelper. The scraper creation is in scraper.go: newKubeletScraper returns scraper.Metrics via scraper.NewMetrics(ks.scrape, scraper.WithStart(ks.start), scraper.WithShutdown(ks.shutdown)). The factory passes the result to scraperhelper.NewMetricsController with AddMetricsScraper.

dockerstatsreceiver.usage: createMetricsReceiver uses scraper.NewMetrics(dsr.scrapeV2, scraper.WithStart(dsr.start), scraper.WithShutdown(dsr.shutdown)), then passes to scraperhelper.NewMetricsController with AddMetricsScraper.

snmpreceiver.usage: createMetricsReceiver uses scraper.NewMetrics(snmpScraper.scrape, scraper.WithStart(snmpScraper.start)), then passes to scraperhelper.NewMetricsController with AddMetricsScraper.

haproxyreceiver.usage: newReceiver uses scraper.NewMetrics(mp.scrape, scraper.WithStart(mp.start)), then passes to scraperhelper.NewMetricsController with AddMetricsScraper.

key_patterns_observed.hostmetrics_sub_scrapers_use_factory_pat: All 11 hostmetrics sub-scrapers (cpu, disk, memory, network, filesystem, load, paging, processes, process, nfs, system) implement scraper.Factory via scraper.NewFactory() with scraper.WithMetrics(), and return scraper.Metrics via scraper.NewMetrics(). The hostmetrics receiver factory aggregates them via map[component.Type]scraper.Factory and uses scraperhelper.AddFactoryWithConfig().
key_patterns_observed.database_receivers_use_direct_scraper_cr: MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Elasticsearch create scraper.Metrics directly in factory.go via scraper.NewMetrics() and pass to scraperhelper.NewMetricsController with AddMetricsScraper. MySQL and PostgreSQL also use scraper.NewLogs() and scraper.NewFactory() for log scraper creation.
key_patterns_observed.some_receivers_split_scraper_creation: Redis and kubeletstats create scraper.Metrics in separate scraper files (redis_scraper.go, scraper.go) rather than in factory.go. Their factory.go files only import scraperhelper, not scraper directly.
key_patterns_observed.scraper_with_shutdown_usage: scraper.WithShutdown is used by: loadscraper (hostmetrics), mysqlreceiver, postgresqlreceiver, mongodbreceiver, redisreceiver, kubeletstatsreceiver, dockerstatsreceiver. Other receivers only use scraper.WithStart.
key_patterns_observed.scraper_logs_usage: Only mysqlreceiver and postgresqlreceiver use scraper.NewLogs() and scraper.NewFactory() with scraper.WithLogs() for log scraping (top queries and query samples).

total_files_using_scraper_package.detail: 15 factory.go files directly import scraper (11 hostmetrics sub-scrapers + mysql + postgresql + mongodb + elasticsearch + dockerstats + snmp + haproxy = 17 factory files). 2 additional factory.go files (redis, kubeletstats) use scraperhelper only, with scraper creation in separate files (redis_scraper.go, scraper.go). Plus 1 internal wrapper (hostmetricsreceiver/internal/scraper.go).
